images.title: Wider turn, larger angle
images.purpose: Show that the more the cover is turned, the greater the angle.
images.composition: Two angles side by side with equal arms, one narrow and one wide, wide space between.
images.exact_structure: Left: two arms of equal length from one vertex, one horizontal, one rising at about 30 degrees, small arc in teal #0072B2. Right: the same arm length, one horizontal and one rising at about 70 degrees from its vertex, arc in amber #E69F00. All four arms exactly equal length. Exactly 2 angles, 2 arcs.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The angle with more turning is the greater angle.
images.description: Two angles with equal arms: a narrow teal one labelled Case 1 and a wider amber one labelled Case 2.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the angle with more turning.
